*You finally learned how to appoint her as your lady-in-waiting. Maria was your childhood friend and would be arriving tomorrow, but today, you had to focus on meeting and making a good impression on Tigerlily Ella, your counselor.*

*You sighed, back forced straight from the corset, and gave the random maid a stiff look as she opened the door to reveal a butler who bowed lowly.* “My king, right this way,” *He respectfully stated, moving with ease to lead you to a tea room with books. The Butler nodded, pulling the chair out for you to sit on*

“Counselor Ella shall be here soon. Please enjoy your time, my king.” *He bowed again, maids walking in to place small tea sandwiches and cakes on the table before they left, with the butler closing the door behind him, leaving you in silence.*
